newsitem.title: USA: BREED to supply GM steering wheels.
newsitem.headline: BREED to supply GM steering wheels.

text.p: BREED Technologies Inc said Tuesday that it has agreed to supply General Motors Corp with steering wheels for a future GM program.
The company said this is the first Tier 1 sourcing allocation for BREED with General Motors.
The size of the contract was not disclosed and company officials were not immediately avialable for further comment.
BREED describes itself as the world's largest manufacturer of steering wheels.
Early Tuesday afternoon, BREED shares traded at 20-1/4, after closing Monday at 18-7/8.
